_comment: OpportunityBoard v0 data. Approved listings go in 'listings'; entries whose deadline has passed are excluded from builds automatically. 'fixtures' is development-only: it is included ONLY when the build runs with OPPORTUNITY_BOARD_DEV=1 and never appears in production builds. Fields: slug, title, hospital, state, city, type (permanent | locum | training/fellowship), specialty, contract_length, remuneration (optional), description, deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), apply_method (email address or https URL), posted_date (YYYY-MM-DD), verified (boolean; shows the Verified badge only when true).

fixtures.title: Registrar, Anaesthesia (development fixture)
fixtures.description: Development fixture used only when OPPORTUNITY_BOARD_DEV=1 is set. This entry never appears in production builds. Its purpose is to exercise the board cards, the filters, the detail page and the JobPosting structured data before real listings exist.
